A hand-curated checklist

Pokémon inthe Park

Across the Sword & Shield era, 28 cards by different illustrators return to the same peaceful park: a stone-ringed pond, curving brick paths, blue benches, and green streetlamps. Follow it through seasons, weather, and times of day, spot Pokémon cameoing in each other’s scenes, and end at Kricketune’s midnight concert.

🌳 One shared park🗂️ 28 cards · 15 sets🎨 26 illustrators

HOW THIS CHECKLIST IS CURATED

What counts as the park?

Cards qualify when the illustration is set in the shared park: the brick loop, the stone-edged pond, the blue benches, and the green streetlamps. Cards are listed in release order, from Sword & Shield to the Crown Zenith finale, so the checklist reads like the park’s story.

Print card-sized placeholders to hold each spot in your binder until the real card arrives. Every sheet is a 3 × 3 grid that matches a 9-pocket binder page.

In your browser’s print dialog, set scale to 100% (or “Actual size”) and turn off “Fit to page” so each placeholder prints at real card size, 63 × 88 mm. Choose “Save as PDF” to keep a copy.
